definicoes_originais: tenant on a fixed rent payable in kind, v. אָרִיס II. Y. Bicc. I, end, 64 b ח' לשעה a tenant for a fixed term, ח' לעולם a permanent tenant (on ground rent).
the fixed annual rent in kind.
notas_originais: B. Mets. 104 a חוֹכֵר; a. fr.— Pl. חֲכִירִין, חֲכוּ', חֲכִירוֹת, (חוֹכְרִין) חֲכוּרוֹת. Y. Bicc. l. c. חֲכוּרֵי בתי אבות hereditary tenants. Tosef. Peah III, 1. Ib. Ter. II, 11 חוכרין ed. Zuck. (Var. חכורות, חכירות). Y. M. Kat. III, 82 b bot. חֲכִירָיו.

B. Mets. IX, 2 (103 b) מנכה לו מן חֲכִירוֹ Talm. ed. (Mish. חֲכוּ') he deducts from the stipulated rent (in proportion). Ib. 4 (105 a) הואיל ואני נותן לך חֲכִירְךָ (Y. ed. חֲכוּרְךָ, Mish. חֲכוּרָהּ) as long as I give thee thy rent (Mish.: the rent for it).
— Pl. חֲכִירֵי. B. Mets. 68 a, v. נַרְשָׁאָה.

Tosef. B. Mets. IX, 24 ח' של שתי שנים Var. (ed. Zuck. only חכורי) the rent for two years in advance.— Pl. חֲכִירִיּוֹת, v. supra.

notas_originais: Naz. 59 a מהו לָחוֹךְ how about (removing the hair by) rubbing (Tosaf.: לחוך ולהִתְחַכֵּךְ about rubbing or being rubbed)?

Ned. I, 1 היה חוֹכֵךְ בזה להחמיר had some hesitation about deciding in favor of greater stringency (for the expression מנודה; oth. opin. in R. N. to Bab. ib. 7 a: denom. of חֵךְ, had a taste for &c.).

B. Kam. IV, 6 שור שהיה מִתְחַכֵּךְ וכ' an ox that scratched himself against a wall; Tosef. ib. IV, 6. B. Kam. 3 a נִתְחַכְּכָה וכ' she (the animal) scratched herself against a wall for her gratification (without intention to do injury) &c.—Naz. 59 a, v. supra; a. fr.

Gen. R. s. 67 (play on הכי, Gen. XXVII, 36) התחיל מְחַכֵּךְ בגרונו וכ' he began to hawk with his throat (to express contempt), like one that hawks and spits; Tanḥ. Ki Thetsé 10; Pesik. Zakh., p. 27 b, v. זְמוֹרָה; [Ar. ed. Koh. s. v. זמר: חִיכְחֵךְ, Pilp.]—Cmp. כָּחַח.

verbetes.glosa_atual: v.חָכָם); ser sábio, saber.; (denominação de חָכָם) reunir-se para deliberação.; tornar-se sábio, tornar-se um erudito.
definicoes_originais: (denom. of חָכָם) to meet for deliberation.
to grow wise, to become a scholar.
to make wise, to stimulate a person’s mind by ingenious suggestions, questions &c. Hag. 14 a תלמיד המַחְכִּים וכ' a student who enlightens his teachers.
notas_originais: Nidd. 70 b מה יעשה אדם ויֶחְכַּם what must one do in order to be wise?
Ib. לכשיחיו נֶחְכַּם להן when they resurrect, we shall meet to discuss their case.

B. Bath. 25 b הרוצה שיַחְכִּים he who desires to become a scholar; ib. 175 b (Ber. 63 b שיִתְחַכֵּם). Ab. II, 5 … לא כל … מַחְכִּים not every one that has a large trade, becomes wise (experienced); a. fr.
B. Mets. 107 b ומַחְכִּימַת פתי and makes the simple wise.

Ex. R. s. 6, beg. ה' על גזרתו וכ' philosophized on (tried to find out the reasons for) the Lord’s law. Ib. מה שהייתי מַחְכִּים וכ' when I philosophised … and made myself believe …, it was all vain boast &c.
Ber. 63 b, v. supra. B. Bath. 25 b מתוך שמִתְחַכֵּם מתעשר because by becoming wise, he will get rich. Pesik. R. s. 33 beg. מאליו נתח' became wise by his own speculation.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (adj. com inflexão verbal); ser sábio, astuto; para ser aprendido.; reconhecer, saber, lembrar.; ser claro, evidente.

to be informed, aware; to learn.

Targ. Y. II Gen. XXXVII, 33 (some ed. חַכַּם Pa.).—Targ. II Esth. II, 18; a. fr.—Lev. R. s. 30 ח' את וכ' doest thou know anything in favor of this man?—Y. M. Kat. III, 83 b top, v. בְּאַר—Y. Ber. II, 4 d top וחַכְמִין אינון כלום do they (the dead) know anything?—Y. Shek. VII, 50 c bot. יֶחְכְּמוּן שפייא קיטריהון let the wine-dealers identify their knots (marks on the wine bottles). Y. Keth. V, 30 a bot. [read:] חֲכִים אנא לחייתא דמילדא לי (or חַכִּים) I (as an infant) recognized the midwife that assisted at my birth (when she came to nurse my mother). Y. Ter. XI, end, 48 b לא אנא ח' לאבא I never knew my father. Y. Ḥag. II, 78 a top יַחְכּוּם shall select (Y. Snh. VI, 23 a bot. יטול), v. זוֹגָא.—2) (euphem. = b. h. יָדַע) to sleep with. Targ. Y. Gen. IV, 1 Ar. (ed. ידע). Targ. Y. II ib. XX, 16; a. e.—Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 55 b bot.; Lam. R. to I, 1 רבתי (חד כותאי
Snh. 42 a, v. זָקֵן I.

Targ. O. Gen. XXVII, 36 (Rashi a. l. quotes וכמני, v. כְּמַן, v. Berl. Targ. O. II, p. 10).
. Targ. Ps. CV, 22; a. e.

. Targ. O. Ex. I, 10.
Y. Sot. IX, 23 c bot.; Y. Yeb. XVI, 15 c מאן דבעי דלא מִתְחַכְּמָה he who desires to disguise himself; לא מִתְחַכְּמִין they were not recognized, v. נְחִירָא.
Targ. Ez. III, 2; a. e.—B. Bath. 158 b אוירא דא"י מַהְכּים the climate of Palestine makes wise.

verbetes.glosa_atual: v. para Levy Talm. Ditado. II, 204 2) [ retentivo,]; aquele que sabe.; homem sábio, erudito; especialmente. Ḥ akham, um título de estudioso, inferior ao de Rabino.; איש ח' לרשעה um homem sábio para a maldade (astuto).
definicoes_originais: v. Fl. to Levy Talm. Dict. II, 204 2) [ retentive,]
wise man, scholar; esp. Ḥ akham, a scholar’s title, less than Rabbi.
איש ח' לרשעה a man wise for wickedness (artful).
notas_originais: חֲכַם הרזים He who knows the secrets (minds of men). Ber. 58 a; Tosef. ib. VII (VI), 2; Num. R. s. 21, beg.
Ab. IV, 1 איזהו ח' who is a wise man? Snh. 21 a (ref. to II Sam. XIII,

Gitt. 67 a ח' וסופר is a scholar and a scribe; ח' לכשירצה might be a scholar, if he wanted. Hor. 13 b ר"מ ח' R. M. was the Ḥ akham (counselor); a. v. fr.— Pl. חֲכָמִים, frequ. in the sense of a number of scholars, as opposed to a single authority. Ḥull. 85 a ראה רבי … ושנאו בלשון ח' Rabbi approving of R. Meir’s opinion …, recorded it in the Mishnah as the opinion of ‘scholars’. Ber. I, 1; a. v. fr.—חַכְמֵי אומות העולם gentile scholars (philosophers), חכמי ישראל Jewish scholars. R. Hash. 12 a. Pes. 94 b; a. fr.—תַּלְמִיד חָכָם (= תלמיד וח', cmp. חָבֵר, abbr. ת"ח) title of a student, disciple, scholar. Ḥag. 15 b ת"ח אע"פ שסרח וכ' a scholar’s learning is not to be despised, even if he has gone astray. Ḥull. 9 a ת"ח צריך וכ' in order to be recognised as a Talmid Ḥ akham, one must have learned three things &c.; a. v. fr.— Pl. תַּלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים. Ber. 64 a ת"ה מרבים וכ' scholars increase the peace of the world; a. v. fr.
, Y. Erub. IX, end, 25 d והח', read והחמם, v. חֲמָם
, v. חוּכְמָא
M. Kat. 9 a bot. ר' יונתן בן ח' Ms. M. (ed. עסמיי, read: עכ'); Y. Ter. XI, end, 48 b עַכְמַאי.
Y. Shek. V, 48 d top הרי זו ח' that is a wise court; Snh. 17 b שלישית ח' a Sanhedrin containing three orators is a wise one.
R. Hash. II, 5; Erub. 45 a ח' הבאה לילד a midwife called for assisting at birth. Sabb. XVIII, 3 וקורין לה ח' וכ' and we must call for her a midwife from another place (on the Sabbath); a. fr.

Ber. 17 a תכלית ח' וכ' the perfection of wisdom is repentance and good deeds. Ib. 33 a ברכת ח' the benediction of wisdom (the fourth of the Prayer of Benedictions). Gen. R. s. 17 חָכְמָתוֹ מרובה וכ' his (Adam’s) wisdom is greater than yours. R. Hash. 29 b שהיא ח' ואינה מלאכה it is an art and not a labor; a. v. fr.—לשון ח' enigmatical speech. Erub. 53 b.—חָכְמַת יונית, v. יְוָנִי.
— Pl. חַכְמָנִיּוֹת. B. Bath. 119 b

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cmp. חָכַךְ) contratar, cultivar, esp. dar ou receber aluguel sobre um aluguel anual fixo pagável em espécie, contrad. para אָרַס, שָׂכַר ou קִבֵּל q. v.—B.; para dar aluguel.
definicoes_originais: (cmp. חָכַךְ) to contract, farm, esp. to give or to take in rent on a fixed annual rental payable in kind, contrad. to אָרַס, שָׂכַר or קִבֵּל q. v.—B.
notas_originais: Mets. IX, 2 חֲכוֹר לי וכ' give me in rent &c. Tosef. Dem. VI, 2 החוֹכֵר שדה if one takes in rent a field. Ib. מה בין שוכר לחוכר what is the difference between the sokher and the ḥ okher?; a. fr.—V. חָכִיר.
Part. מַחְכִּיר landlord. B. Mets. 104 a; a. e.— Part. pass. מוּחְכָּר, f. מוּחְכֶּרֶת. B. Bath. 123 b, sq. פרה מ' a cow rented out for half-profit (Rashi).
B. Mets. 68 a חַכְרָהּ, v. מַשְׁכֵּן. Y. Maas. Sh. V, 56 b bot. [read:] כד … חַכְרִין … תַחְכְּרוּן וכ' when you rent land, rent only from God-fearing men.
B. Mets. 104 a (Rashi: חֲכִירוּת).
, v. הַכְשָׁרָה

Targ. Gen. XXXII, 13; a. fr.—Pes. 113 a, v. אַדְּ־.— Pl. חָלָתָא (fem.). Sabb. 110 a בי ח' between the sand-mounds.

Ab. Zar. II, 6 ח' שחֲלָבוֹ וכ' milk (of a cow) milked by a gentile. Makhsh. VI, 5 מי ח' serum of milk; a. fr.—בשר בח' the boiling of meat with milk, the prohibitory law concerning &c. (Ex. XXIV, 19; XXXIV, 26; Deut. XIV, 21). Pes. 54 b, v. חִידּוּשׁ.—Ḥull. 110 a לא גמירי דב' בח' אסור they did not know that boiling meat with milk was forbidden; a. fr.—חֲלֵב בֵּיצִים white of eggs. Y. Targ. Gen. XVIII, 8. Targ. Job X, 10; a. fr.—Y. Ter. VIII, 46 a חַלְבּוּן חֲ' milked. Ḥull. 109 b, v. בִּשְׂרָא I. Ib. 110 a; a. e.

notas_originais: Ab. Zar. II, 6, v. חָלָב. Bekh. 20 b רוב … חוֹלְבוֹת וכ' the majority of animals secrete no milk unless they have given birth; a. fr.
Sabb. 53 b לֵיחָלֵב when the bag is tied on for milking purposes (to support the udders), opp. ליבש for drying up.
Y. Ter. VIII, 46 a, v. חֲלָב

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.) concreção gordurosa (cmp. חַלָּא), esp. aquela gordura abdominal do gado que é proibido comer, ḥ eleb (Lev. III, 17), contrad. para שומן.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) fatty concretion (cmp. חַלָּא), esp. that abdominal fat of cattle which it is forbidden to eat, ḥ eleb (Lev. III, 17), contrad. to שומן.
notas_originais: Kerith. III, 1. Ḥull. 113 b המבשל חֵ' בחָלָב if one boils fat with milk. Snh. 4 b חֵלֶב וחָלָב דכי וכ' ḥ eleb a. ḥ alab which are written alike, v. אֵם; a. fr.— Pl. חֲלָבִים, חֲלָבִין. Ber. I, 1 ח' ואברים the pieces of fat and the limbs belonging to the altar; Tam. VII, 3 שלחן הח' the (marble) table designated for the fat-pieces (and limbs).—Ker. 12 a, sq. חֲלָבִין laws concerning the eating of ḥ eleb; Y. Yeb. X, 11 a top מדמי לה לח' (not לחלבון); a. fr.—[Y. Ter. X, 47 b bot. לובן חלבין, v. חֶלְבּוֹן.]—גוּשׁ הֵ', v. גּוּשׁ.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (composto de חָלָב a. בֵּיצָה) bulbo de ornithogalum.
definicoes_originais: (compound of חָלָב a. בֵּיצָה) bulb of ornithogalum.
notas_originais: Shebi. VII, 2; expl. Y. ib. 37 b bot. בֵּיצֵי נֵץ חָלָב eggs (bulbs) of &c., v. חָלָב; Tosef. ib. V, 6; Nidd. 62 a הַלְּבֵיצִין (absorbing ח); Sabb. 90 a החל'. Tosef. Kil. III, 12 הלבוצין.

Erub. 28 a ובחל' (Ms. M. ובגלוגות, read: ובַלַּגְל', v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note, ח' absorbed, v. preced.); Y. Peah VIII, 21 a top; Y. Erub. III, 20 d top, expl. פרפחיניה. Shebi. IX, 1 (Mish. ed. גית …, read: … גות; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note). Y. ib. 38 c (Rabbi’s maid said) נתפזרו חֲלוֹגְלגוֹתֶיךָ thy purslane plants have been scattered; R. Hash. 26 b חֲלוֹגְלוֹגְךָ (Ms. M. לגלוגך). Ib. לא ידעי רבנן מאי חלוגל' (Mss. לגל').

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cmp. חלל) minar, cavar, cavar.; mesmo. Y. Kil. IX, 32 mesmo.; passar a faca de abate sob cobertura, espremer-se.
definicoes_originais: to pass the slaughtering knife under cover, to squeeze in.
notas_originais: Pes. 118 b שחוֹלֶדֶת בעיקרי וכ' Ms. M. (ed. as in Ḥull. 20 b הדרה) which undermines the foundations &c. V. חוּלְדָּה.

Y. Kil. IX, 32 c top מַחִלִיד הב"ה … את וכ' the Lord caves the ground before them and they roll &c.; Y. Keth. XII, 35 b top מהלך … אל (corr. acc.). B. Bath. 19 b מפני שמַחְלִידִין וכ' because their roots undermine the ground.

Ḥull. II, 4. Ib. 20 b; a. fr.—Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. I, 5 מפני שהכובס אומן מַחֲלִידוֹ לתוכו (R. S. to Kel. XXI, 1) because so much of it does the professional fuller fold up for inserting a rod into it (v. חוֹב II, 2).
pass. חָלִיד covered with earth, mouldering. Targ. Job XI, 17 Ms. (ed. דחלך, דהלך, corr. acc.).
Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII, 14 אין ח' אלא ארץ ḥ eled means earth (ref. to Ps. XLIX, 2). Tanḥ. Ki Thabo 2 (ref. to Ps. XVII, 14) הן מתים מח' they die away from this world, v. חֲלוּדָה.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חָלַד Hif.) passando a faca sob a cobertura.
definicoes_originais: (חָלַד Hif.) passing the knife under cover.
notas_originais: Ḥull. 9 a; 27 a; a. e.
, v. חֲלוּדָה
Targ. Y. Num. XXXI, 22 (v. Rashi a. l.).
Gen. R. s. 37, transl. of חִוִּי (Gen. X, 17); cmp. חִוְיָא.
, v. חלי

verbetes.glosa_atual: bolo [enrolado, arredondado].; (com referência ao Num. XV, 20, sq.) Ḥ allah, a parte da massa do sacerdote.
definicoes_originais: (with ref. to Num. XV, 20, sq.) Ḥ allah, the priest’s share of the dough.
notas_originais: — Pl. חַלּוֹת. Ukts. III, 5 ח' חריע (Tosef. Maas. Sh. I, 13 חַלַּת (collect. noun), a. e., v. חֲרִיעַ.—Men. III, 6 שתי ח' the two loaves (offered on the Feast of Weeks, Lev. XXIII, 17).—B. Bath. V, 3; Ukts. III, 11 ח' דבש honey-combs; a. fr.

Sabb. II, 6, v. זָהִיר. Ḥall. I, 1 חייבין בח' are subject to the law of Ḥ allah.—Ib. II, 7 שעור הח' the quantity to be set aside for the priest. Ib. 8 מעיסה שלא הורמה חַלָּתָהּ Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) from a dough from which the priest’s share has not yet been taken; a. fr.— Pl. as ab. Pesik. Shimu, p. 118 a שתי ח' two portions (one for being burnt, and one for the priest); Y. Erub. III, end, 21 c; Cant. R. to I 6; a. e.—Trnsf. ḥ allah, the sanctification of creation, man. Gen. R. s. 14, beg.; Yalk. Prov. 962, a. e. (ref. to Prov. XXIX, 4, ואיש תרומות) that is Adam שהיה גמר חַלָּתוֹ וכ' who was the final sanctification of the world; Gen. R. s. 17, end.— Ḥ allah, name of a treatise of the Mishnah, Tosefta a. Talm. Y., of the Order of Z’raïm.
, v. חֲלַגְלֹוג

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חָלַד) [cobertura de terra etc., mofando por estar em uma caverna,]; ferrugem, mofo.; uma doença de pele decorrente da vida em cavernas.
definicoes_originais: (חָלַד) [ covering of earth &c., mouldering from being in a cave,]
a skin disease arising from living in caves.
notas_originais: Kel. XIII, 5 העלתה ה' became rusty; Tosef. ib. B. Mets. III, 10; a. fr.—Trnsf. sin. Tanḥ. Ki Thabo 2 (ref. to חלד Ps. XVII, 14) [read:] אמרו זה לזה ח' הם מלאין חטאין יש בידן (v. Tanḥ. ed. Bub. ib. 4) they (the gentiles) say to one another, they (the Israelites) are full of rust, there are sins in their hands.

Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII, 14 (v. supra) אלו שהעלה גופן ח' they are those (persecuted Jews) whose bodies became afflicted with sores, &c.; Y. Shebi. IX, 38 d; Gen. R. s. 79.— Pl. חֲלוּדוֹת. Pesik. B’shall., p. 88 b; Esth. R. to I, 9 חֲלוּדָאוֹת (some ed. חלדואות, corr. acc.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: Halvan ( Ḥ olvân) na Assíria (b. h. חלח, v. P. Sm. 1277, Neub. Géogr. p. 373).
definicoes_originais: Halvan ( Ḥ olvân) in Assyria (b. h. חלח, v. P. Sm. 1277, Neub. Géogr. p. 373).
notas_originais: Kidd. 72 a; Yeb. 16 b Ms. M. (ed. חלזון, corr. acc.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חלז) nó ou tipoia da parte superior da roupa quando levantada, (seio).
definicoes_originais: (חלז) knot or sling of the upper garment when lifted, ( sinus).
notas_originais: Targ. II Esth. I, 2 (3) וחליזת חִילּוּזָהּ she lifted her garment.—Pes. 113 a תמרי בחֲלוּזָךְ וכ' if thou bringest dates home, with thy sinus (before ungirding) run to the brewery; [comment.: with the dates tied up in thy bag]. V. חוּלְזָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: m. = הֶחְלֵט. Tosef. Neg. VIII, 6 בימי חִלּוּטוֹ durante seus dias de lepra declarada.
notas_originais: m. = הֶחְלֵט. Tosef. Neg. VIII, 6 בימי חִלּוּטוֹ during his days of declared leprosy.
m., v. חָלַט

לחֲ' finally, permanently, absolutely (b. h. לִצְמִיתוּת). Targ. Lev. XXV, 23; a. e.—Ex. R. s. 3; Arakh. 15 b; Snh. 106 b.—Lev. R. s. 7, end, v. יְרִיבָה.—V. חַלְטָנִית.—בח' by final decision (from which there is no appeal). Gen. R. s. 42; Yalk. ib. 72; Koh. R. to V, 15 היך מה דאתא בחלו' וכ' Ar. (ed. בחלי') as man enters this world by final decision, so does he leave it it (cmp. Ab. IV, 22).—[Gen. R. s. 94, beg. חלוטין, v. חֲלִיטָא III.]
, v. sub חִילּ'.

— Pl. חֲלוּלִים, חֲלוּלִין. Sifra K’dosh. Par. 1; Yalk. Lev. 604 the idols are called אֱלִילִים, על שם שהם ח' because they are hollow.—Ber. 60 b ח' ח' Ms. F. a. oth. (ed. חֲלָלִים) full of channels (bowels &c.).

Ber. 55 a; a. fr.— Pl. חֲלוֹמוֹת. Ib. b; a. fr.—Ib. 10 b בעל הח' the genius of dream.—[חלומות דהרואה that portion of the chapter Haroëh, in B’rakhoth, treating of dreams: Ber. 55 a to 57 b; often quoted in Ar. a. oth.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: c. (b. h.; חלל) perfuração, abertura, janela.
definicoes_originais: c. (b. h.; חלל) perforation, aperture, window.
notas_originais: B. Bath. III, 6 ח' המצרית וכ' the Egyptian window (a very small aperture in the wall) gives no privilege (v. חֲזָקָה), i.e. the neighbor may build against it, contrad. to הצורית a Tyrian window. Gen. R. s. 31, expl. צהר (Gen. VI, 16); a. v. fr.— Pl. חַלּוֹנוֹת. Y. R. Hash. II, 58 a; Ex. R. s. 15 שס"ה ח' וכ' 365 apertures did the Lord create in the sky; a. fr.
, v. חִילּ'
Ber. 16 b חיים של ח' עצמות (missing in Mss., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 5) a life of healthfull energy (v. Is. LVIII, 11).
Targ. Y. II Gen. XVI, 7; Ex. XV, 22 (h. text שׁוּר). Targ. Y. Gen. XVI, 14 (h. text בָּרֶד).—Gen. R. s. 45; Yalk. ib. 79 (expl. בדרך שור, Gen. XVI, 7) באורחא דח' on the road of Ḥ.—V. חַגְרָא I.
f., v. חָלַץ

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חָלַק, v. חָלָק) vestimenta lisa e lisa, em gen. camiseta.
definicoes_originais: (חָלַק, v. חָלָק) plain, smooth garment, in gen. undershirt.
notas_originais: Kel. XXVIII, 9, v. חוּץ II.—M. Kat. 14 a, a. e. כל … אלא ח' אחד he who has only one shirt. Ab. Zar. 34 a ח' לבן a plain white frock, v. אִימְּרָה. Y. Taan. II, 65 d (ref. to I Sam. VII, 6) לבש שמואל חֲלוּקָן וכ' Samuel put on the common shirt of all Israelites, i.e. included himself among the sinners; a. fr.—Trnsf. a) a shirt-shaped bandage. Sabb. XIX, 2 (drawn over the circumcised membrum).—b) a row, layer. Y. Pes. I, 27 b bot. מפשיטו ח' אחד he strips it of one shirt, i.e. removes one row all around the pile of bottles.— Pl. חֲלוּקִים, חֲלוּקִין, חֲלוּקֹות. M. Kat. 22 b. Y. l. c. שני חלקות (read: חלוק') two rows. Tosef. Kil. V, 6 שני ח' two shirts of different materials (כִּלְאַיִם). Lam. R. introd. (R. Abbahu 2); ib. to III, 13 והח' שלו עליו (the camel) with his covers on; a. fr.
, v. חִילּוּק

ch. = h. חָלוּק I. Targ. Y. Ex. XXII, 26 ח' תותביה ed. pr. (later ed. only תות').—Lam. R. introd. (R. Abbahu 5); ib. to III, 13 כח' דיהודאי וכ' as long as a Jewish Sabbath shirt (transmitted from father to son).—Sabb. 134 a ח' דינוקא the child’s bandage, v. חָלוּק I

B. Bath. 122 a לא כח' של עוה"ז וכ' the distribution of land in the future will not be like the one of the present. Ib. 126 a יש לו לבכור קודם ח' the first-born is the legal owner of his share before the partition has taken place. Keth. 26 a בתורת ח' as an heir’s share. Ib. 94 b ח' עדיפא division among two claimants (where evidence is wanted) is preferable (to discretionary adjudication to one, v. שׁוּדָּא); a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , apenas em (פול) ח' נפש [ suavizando a alma,] nome de uma espécie de feijão = שעועית.
definicoes_originais: , only in (פול) ח' נפש [ smoothing the soul,] name of a species of bean = שעועית.
notas_originais: Nidd. IX, 7 (expl. מי גריסין) לעיסת גריסין של פול ח' נ' a chewed mass of grist of beans named ḥălukath nefesh (Rashi: beans split to the core, v. חֶילְקָא II); [Tosef. ib. VIII, 9 עז עיקת נפש ed. Zuck. (Var. ער עוקת נתש); Gen. R. s. 94, beg. פול שהוא על עיקת נפש; Yalk. ib. 152 שבאין על עקת נפש the bean-grist used for (relieving) the pressure of the soul; cmp. Y. Kil. I, 27 b top, etymol. of שְׁעוּעִית, a. B. Bath. 16 a, quot. s. v. עֲדַשָּׁה.—Our w. is prob. a popular re-adaptation of Alica, v. Sm. Ant. s. v.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: , Pa. חַלֵּיז (cmp. חלץ) para cingir, para formar um seio; para levantar o manto.
definicoes_originais: , Pa. חַלֵּיז (cmp. חלץ) to gird, to form a sinus; to lift the cloak.
notas_originais: Targ. II Esth. I, 2 (3), v. חֲלוּז.— Part. pass. מְחַלַּז. Ib. IV, 11 ומְחַלְּזִין חולזוי his loins girt (his cloak lifted up, ready for labor).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. precedido.); animal conchífero, caracol, ostra, esp. peixe roxo, casca roxa usada para morrer t’kheleth (תְּכֵלֶת).; nome de um besouro ou gafanhoto, v. próximo w.—Y.; (cmp. Lat. Cóclea) um pedaço de corrente em forma de caracol, parafuso.
definicoes_originais: conchiferous animal, snail, oyster, esp. purple-fish, purple-shell used for dying t’kheleth (תְּכֵלֶת).
name of a beetle or locust, v. next w.—Y.
(cmp. Lat. Cochlea) a snail-shaped piece of a chain, screw.
notas_originais: Snh. 91 a ח' אחד (ed. אחת, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 60 a. Ar. s. v.). Pesik. B’shall. p. 92 a ח' הזה וכ' as the snail grows, its shell grows with it; Deut. R. s. 7, end—Sabb. 26 a (expl. יגבים, Jer. LII, 16) ציידי ח' וכ' the shellfishers from &c. Men. 44 a. Meg. 6 a; a. fr.— Pl. חִלְזוֹנוֹת. Snh. l. c.
Sabb. I, 3 b. Yalk. Ex. 185; Tanḥ. Vaera, ed. Bub. 19.
Kel. XII, 1; Tosef. ib. B. Mets. II, 3.
Bekh. VI, 2; ib. 38 b. Sifra Emor ch. II, Par. 3.—[Kidd. 72 a; Yeb. 16 b, v. חַלְוָון.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: ,; peixe roxo; lesma.; besouro ou gafanhoto.; uma afeição dos olhos.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. I Deut. XXXIII, 19 (v. Meg. 6 a).— Pl. חִלְזוֹנֵי. Ab. Zar. 28 b, v. מִשְׁקְדֵי.
Targ. Y. Deut. XXVIII, 42 Ar. (ed. חלנונא, h. text צלצל).
Targ. Y. I Lev. XXI, 20 Ar. a. oth. (ed. חִלָּזוֹן; Y. II יחלזווה, read: דחִלְזוֹנָה; v. חִלִּיז).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חִלְחֵל) penetração de uma substância venenosa, veneno.
definicoes_originais: (חִלְחֵל) penetration of a poisonous substance, poison.
notas_originais: Tanḥ. Mishp. 18; ed. Bub. 12 (חול', corr. acc.) הח' היה נכנס וכ' the poison (of the flies) entered their bodies; Yalk. Ex. 359.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. precedido.) enrolamento; por favor. חַלְחוֹלִיּוֹת intrigas.
notas_originais: Lev. R. s. 20 (expl. להוללים, Ps. LXXV, 5) למערבביא אלו שלבם … ח' רעות (some ed. חַלְחֹלִיּוֹת) to those creating confusion, those whose hearts are full of evil intrigues; Tanḥ. Aḥăré 2 חלחל'; Yalk. Lev. 524 חוּלְחָלִיּוֹת; Yalk. Ps. 811; [Lev. R. s. 17 (ref. to Ps. LXXIII, 3) במערבא אומרים אלו … הוֹלֵלוֹת וכ' (read: במְעַרְבָּבַיָּא אלו), v. הוֹלֵלָה].

verbetes.glosa_atual: (próximo w.; v. precedido. wds.) mesentério, uma membrana que mantém as entranhas em posição.
definicoes_originais: (next w.; v. preced. wds.) mesentery, a membrane keeping the entrails in position.
notas_originais: Ḥull. 50 a

verbetes.glosa_atual: penetrar em cavidades; perfurar.; agitar, rolar (em um recipiente etc.); enxaguar.; , Nithpalp.; para permear.
definicoes_originais: to penetrate into cavities; to perforate.
to shake, roll (in a vessel &c.); to rinse.
to be shaken in a hollow space, to be thrown about.
to be permeated (with poison) to be affected, injured.
(cmp. חָלָה) to be weakened, be neutralized.
notas_originais: Sot. 7 b; Num. R. s. 9 מְחַלְחֵל ויורד (the powder on a wound) penetrates and goes down (into the body). Gen. R. s. 98 ריסו מח' וכ' its venom penetrates (the body of the bitten one) after (the serpent’s) death.

Makhsh. III, 6 ח' לתוכן if he washed olives by rolling them in the rain water.— Part. pass. מְחוּלְחָל, f. מְחוּלְחֶלֶת hollow, blown up; loosely put in. Oh. IX, 7 כלי מח' a hollow vessel (not packed entirely), opp. אֲפוּצָה. Kel. X, 3 מגופת החבית המח' וכ' (Bart. המִתְחַלְחֶ') the stopper of a keg which can be moved around, without, however, falling out of itself. Teb. Yom I, 1; a. fr.
נִתְהַלְחֵל
Num. R. s. 9 שהם מִתְחַלְחֲלִים וכ' that they will permeate all her limbs.
Mikv. IV, 3 היו צרורות מתח' וכ' if pebbles rolled about in the spout.
Y. B. Kam. I, beg. 2 b ונתח' כולו and the whole of it is damaged (by the heat &c.).
Y. Ter. VIII, 46 a top ע"י מליחה מתח' through salting it, the poison is neutralized.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , penetrar, esvaziar.; ser perfurado, estar aberto.; tremer.
notas_originais: Ḥull. 119 b חַלְחוּלֵי מְחַלְחֵל the hair perforates the skin.— Part. pass. מְחַלְחַל hollow; loosely filled. Ber. 59 a ענני חלחולי מְחַלְחֲלֵי (Ms. F. עיבא … מִיחַלְחַל) the clouds are not entirely filled with water. Pes. 74 a איידי דמח' because the wood is hollow (having marrow inside); a. e.

Ber. l. c. Ms. F. v. supra.—Esp. to be permeated by poison, feel the effect of poison. Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41 a bot.; Y. Ter. VIII, 45 c bot. לא אספיק … עד דאיתח' he had scarcely drank of it when he became affected (collapsed). Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40 d top חמתה מִתְהַלְחֲלָה he saw that the plaster was poisoned.
Targ. Ps. XCVII, 4. Targ. Y. Ex. XXXII, 11 (h. text ויחל); a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. חָלַט II, a. Syr.; tornar-se consistente através da agitação.
notas_originais: חלט P. Sm. 1277) bind up, mix, esp. to stir flour in hot water, v. חֲלִיטָה II.— Part. pass. חָלוּט a paste prepared by stirring, dumpling. Y. Ḥall. I, 58 a top; Y. Maasr. I, 49 b ח' ברור a real ḥ alut (concerning which there is no doubt as to the obligation of Ḥ allah). Y. Ab. Zar. II, 42 a top ה' מחוסר וכ' the ḥ alut (prepared by a gentile) wants finishing through fire (frying or boiling); a. fr.
Y. Hall. l. c. נֶחְלְטָה כל צורכה sufficiently stirred to be a consistent paste-ball.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ,; fazer uma pasta.; (cmp. próximo wds. a. צמת) causar contração por escaldamento ou colocação de vinagre.; para causar contração, para escaldar, coloque vinagre.
definicoes_originais: (cmp. next wds. a. צמת) to cause contraction by scalding or by putting in vinegar.
to cause contraction, to scald, put in vinegar.
to be mixed up, to mingle.
notas_originais: . Targ. II Sam. XIII, 6.
Part. pass. חָלִיט. Ḥull. 111 a ח' הוי מעיקרא Rashi (ed. מִיּחֲלַט הוה ח' ליה וכ') it (the liver) was first scalded (so as to emit no blood in boiling).
Ib. חַלְּטֵי ליה וכ'. Pes. 74 b bot. חלא דח' ביה וכ' vinegar which one has used once for drawing the blood from meat and contracting the blood vessels, must not be used a second time.
Targ. Prov. XX, 19; XXIV, 21 (h. text תתערב).
Ib. XIV, 16 (h. text מתעבר!).

verbetes.glosa_atual: [cercar, amarrar (correspondente a b. h. צמת),]; para fazer o final.; emitir o julgamento final sobre um leproso após a prisão probatória (Lev. XIII).; para fazer um julgamento final, para tornar válido; para julgar.
definicoes_originais: [ to surround, tie up (corresp. to b. h. צמת),]
to pass final judgment on a leper after probationary enclosure (Lev. XIII).
to pass final judgment, to make valid; to adjudicate.
to declare a person a leper.
notas_originais: Part. pass. חָלוּט, f. חֲלוּטָה permanently sold, irredeemable. Arakh. IX, 4 הגיע … היה ח' וכו' (Talm. ed. 31 a היתה ח', read: חלוטה) when the last day … had passed and it (the house) was not redeemed, it was his forever …, for we read לצמיתות (Lev. XXV, 30); (Tosef. ib. V, 10 צמת). Arakh. l. c. בראשונה … שיהא ח' לו formerly the purchaser used to hide himself on the last day … in order that it might become his irredeemably; Sifra B’har ch. V, Par. 4 שתהא חלוטה לו. Arakh. 31 b למי ח' to which (of the two buyers) did it belong finally?; a. fr.—V. חֲלוּטִין.
Zeb. 102 a אני מסגירה ואני חוֹלְטָהּ וכ' I will lock her up, declare her a leper and discharge her.

Y. Dem. VII, beg. 26 a צריך להַחֲלִיט וכ' he must make the consecrating conditions valid by speech. Y. Keth. X, 33 d bot. אי זה … להַחֲלִיט מַחֲלִיטִין which of them the court chooses to declare valid, it may &c. Gen. R. s. 61 שלא תַחֲלִיט להם וכ' lest thou surrender the country to them (through bad argument); Yalk. ib. 110 (insert להם). Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39 b top גסות … היא הֶחֱלִיטָתוֹ his haughtiness made Jerob. a confirmed sinner; a. e.

Y. M. Kat. I, 80 c bot. מטמא ומַחֲלִיט declares him unclean and this a decided leper; ורבנן … ומַחֲלִיטִין and the Rabbis say, he must be examined as if it were a new case, but at all events they declare &c.— Part. pass. מוּחֲלָט, f. מוּחֲלֶטֶת 1) irrevocable, confirmed. Yoma 86 b תשובת המוּחֲלָטִין the repentance of the confirmed sinners.—2) the declared leper, opp. to מוּסְגָּר. Meg. I, 7. Yeb. 103 b. Tosef. Naz. VI, 1 מ' בספק one declared a leper from doubt; Y. ib. VIII, end, 57 b; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ,; Papel.; condenar um leproso.; vender irremediavelmente, perder.
notas_originais: pass. חָלִיט, חֲלִיטָא irredeemably sold. Targ. Y. Gen. XLVII, 20.
Targ. Y. Deut. XXI, 5 למִחְלוֹט, v. Af.

Y. Pes. IV, 31 b bot. ולא יְחַלְּטוּן בניהון that they might not forfeit their pledged children. Y. Shebi. VI, 36 c bot. [read:] בגין דלא תְחַלְּטוּן … בידן that you might not surrender the government to their (the Samaritans’) hands. Y. Keth. IX, 33 b bot. אנן מְחַלְּטִין וכ' we shall declare their property forfeited. Arakh. 31 b ולחַלְּטֵיה הקדש let the sacred treasury be declared its permanent owner; a. e.
Targ. Y. Lev. XIII, 11.—Part. pass. מַחְלַט, f. מַחְלְטָא. Ib. 51.
Arakh. 32 b וירושלים מי מִיחֲלַט בה are buildings in Jerusalem ever irredeemable?
— Pl. חַלְטָאתָא. B. Mets. 16 b שטרי ח' legal documents giving the claimant the title for the seized property.
Y. Gitt. IV, end, 46 b (expl. לצמיתות, Lev. XXV, 23) לחול'; Y. Dem. IV, 24 d bot.—Gen. R. s. 28, end, v. זְרִיבָה; a. e.
